question.text: Seven capacitors, each of capacitance $2 \mu \mathrm{F},$ are to be connected in a configuration to obtain an effective capacitance of $\left(\frac{6}{13}\right) \mu \mathrm{F} .$ Which of the combinations, shown in figures below, will achieve the desired value?
